services.desc: Greenville’s West End is at the epicenter of one of the Upstate's most thriving communities. Located on South Main Street, Zen Greenville is the Upstate's premier fully functional event venue due to our customizable event packages which include catering, state of the art in-house audio visual, rentals and more which creates a seamless, turnkey event for our clients. Zen Greenville is one venue featuring four unique spaces that can cater to events of all sizes. Hold your company’s annual board meeting in our executive suite, host a glitzy fundraising gala in our modern studio space, or plan your company holiday party in our striking Lotus Lounge.
